# Advanced Obsidian Tasks format examples

## Recurrence patterns

- [ ] Daily standup 🔁 every weekday 📅 2026-06-01
- [ ] Weekly review 🔁 every Monday 📅 2026-06-01
- [ ] Biweekly meeting 🔁 every 2 weeks 📅 2026-06-01
- [ ] Monthly report 🔁 every month 📅 2026-06-01
- [ ] Quarterly planning 🔁 every 3 months 📅 2026-06-01
- [ ] Annual review 🔁 every year 📅 2026-06-27

## Recurring tasks with metadata

- [ ] Daily check-in 📅 2026-06-01 🔁 every weekday
- [ ] Weekly standup 📅 2026-06-02 🔁 every Monday 🔼
- [ ] Monthly sync 📅 2026-06-15 🔁 every month 🔺 ⏱️ 1h

## Nested recurring tasks

- [ ] Sprint planning 📅 2026-06-02 🔁 every 2 weeks 🔺 ⏱️ 2h
  - [ ] Review backlog
  - [ ] Estimate items
  - [ ] Assign team members
- [ ] Weekly retrospective 📅 2026-05-30 🔁 every Friday ⏫ ⏱️ 1h 30m
  - [ ] What went well?
  - [ ] What did not?
  - [ ] Action items
